responsibility: This module is the root of GCC’s GNU Modula-2 front end, covering the language’s integration with the GCC driver, build/configure system, front-end hooks, options, and language-specific tree support rather than target back-end code or individual library implementations. Its main files register gm2 with GCC’s multi-language build machinery and configure probes, define the gm2 and cc1gm2 driver/spec behavior and command-line option tables, implement the Modula-2 lang_hooks interface to GCC parsing, tree, gimplification, exception, and type machinery, and add small Modula-2-specific tree definitions and pretty-print/debug support. The module also includes versioning and internals documentation, so taken together it represents the top-level control and integration layer that makes GNU Modula-2 function as a GCC language front end.
